q: Select the indirect form of speech: My father said, "All that glitters is not gold."
o: My father remarked that all that glitters is not gold.
My father advised that all that glitters is not gold.
My father said that all that glitters is not gold.
My father said that all that glitters was not gold.

q: He said, ‘Good gracious! What a huge snake!’ (Direct -Indirect)
o: He exclaimed with wonder that it was a huge snake.
He exclaimed at good gracious that it was a huge snake.
He exclaimed with wonder at the snake that it was good.
He said that the snake was big.

q: Akhi said to me, ''I want to go to school now.''
o: Akhi said to me that she wanted to go to school now.
Akhi told me that she wants to go to school then.
Akhi told me that she wanted to go to school then.
Akhi said to me that she wants to go to school now.

q: Evan said to me, "Let us go out for a walk." (make it indirect)
o: Evan proposed to me that we should go out for a walk.
Evan told me that we should go out for a walk.
Evan proposed that we should go out for a walk.
Evan said to me that we should go out for a walk.

q: She said to him, "Please help me." (Make it indirect)
o: She told him help her.
She advised him helping her.
She said him to help her.
She requested him to help her.

q: I said to you, “He has done his duty.” Make it indirect speech.
o: I said to you that you have done your duty
I said to you that he had done his duty
I told you that you had done your duty
I told you that he has done your duty
e: Reported speech-এর present perfect (has done) indirect-এ past perfect (had done) হয়, কারণ reporting verb past। He এখানে তৃতীয় ব্যক্তি, তাই he-ই থাকে এবং his duty-ও অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। তাই “I said to you that he had done his duty”। অন্য অপশনে you/your বসে তৃতীয় ব্যক্তিকে শ্রোতা বানিয়ে ফেলা হয়েছে, আর ‘has done’ কাল বদলায়নি।

q: Kamal said, "I shall start the project next week." (make it indirect)
o: Kamal said that he will be starting the project next week.
Kamal said that he would start the project the following week.
Kamal said that he shall start the project next week.
Kamal requested that he would start the project next week.

q: Rahul said to me, "Do you like football?" [change the narration]
o: Rahul asked me do I like football.
Rahul said if I like football.
Rahul told me that I like football.
Rahul asked me if I liked football.

q: Which one is the correct indirect speech?
o: He asked me where was I going.
He asked me where am I going.
He asked me where I was going.
He asked me where I am going yesterday.
e:
Indirect speech-এ প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য সাধারণ বাক্যের মতো সাজাতে হয়, অর্থাৎ subject আগে এবং verb পরে বসে (statement order)। তাই 'where was I' ভুল, সঠিক হলো 'where I was going'। Reporting verb 'asked' অতীত হওয়ায় বক্তব্যের verb-ও অতীত রূপে (was) আসে।
মনে রাখুন:
প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন (?) indirect speech-এ বসে না।
উদাহরণ:
Direct: He said, "Where do you live?"
Indirect: He asked where I lived.

o: He told me if I had prepared my lesson.
He asked me if I had prepared my lesson.
He said to me if I had prepared my lesson.
He ordered me if I had prepared my lesson.

o: Toni said that she must write a letter.
Toni said that she had to write a letter.
Toni said that she wrote a letter.
Toni said that he shas to write a letter.

q: Mina said to her classmates, “Let’s organize a study session today.” (Make it indirect.)
o: Mina said to her classmates that they had organized a study session that day.
Mina suggested to her classmates that they should organize a study session that day.
Mina told her classmates that they organize a study session that day.
Mina requested her classmates that they should organize a study session today.
e: Let's বা Let us দিয়ে প্রস্তাব বোঝায়, তাই indirect-এ said বদলে suggested বা proposed হয়। Quotation চিহ্ন সরে that আসে এবং Mina ও তার সহপাঠীরা মিলে "us" হওয়ায় সর্বনাম they হয়, তারপর should ও verb-এর মূল রূপ বসে। Today বদলে that day হয়, কারণ reporting verb past। সঠিক রূপ: Mina suggested to her classmates that they should organize a study session that day. Requested অনুরোধের অর্থ দেয়, আর had organized অতীতে সম্পন্ন কাজ বোঝায়, যা এখানে ভুল।

o: Ali has told his friend that he will attend the meeting and he will come later.
Ali told his friend that he will attend the meeting and he will come later.
Ali has told his friend that he would attend the meeting and he should come later.
Ali has told his friend that he should attend the meeting and he would come later.

q: I said to him, “May Allah grant you a long life”. (Make it indirect)
o: I wished him Allah may grant him a long life.
I wished him Allah might grant him a long life.
I prayed to him that Allah might grant him a long life.
I wished him may Allah grant him a long life.

q: The weatherman predicted, "It will rain tomorrow." (Make it indirect)
o: The weatherman predicted that it will be rain the next day.
The weatherman predicted that it will be rained the next day.
The weatherman predicted that it would be rained the next day.
The weatherman predicted that it would rain the next day.
e: Direct speech-এর reporting verb অতীত কালের (predicted) হলে reported speech-ও অতীত রূপে যায়। তখন will বদলে would হয়, can বদলে could হয় এবং tomorrow বদলে the next day বা the following day হয়। Inverted comma তুলে সেখানে that বসে। উদাহরণ: She said, 'I shall help you' হয়ে যায় She said that she would help me। তাই The weatherman predicted that it would rain the next day শুদ্ধ। অন্য অপশনে would be rained বা will be rain-এর মতো ভুল গঠন আছে।
